name: Stone Cairn Lake
summary: At Stone Cairn Lake in northeastern Elwynn, hostile murlocs hold the southern shore and renegade wizards camp on the island. Heroes' Vigil honors those lost in the First War.

sections.title: A Monument Besieged
sections.body: Families and pilgrims once crossed the calm waters to honor the dead at Heroes' Vigil. The stone memorial was raised on the lake's central island to mark the heavy loss of human life in the First War against the Orcish Horde. Now renegade wizards have made camp beside the monument, and the island has become a hostile place.

sections.title: Shores of the Lake
sections.body: Aggressive murlocs have claimed the southern banks of Stone Cairn Lake. Their crude huts line the water, and they harass anyone who comes near. The hills and rocky outcrops around the lake hold rich mineral veins, drawing prospectors and miners despite the dangers along the shore.

faq.q: Why is it called Stone Cairn Lake?
faq.answer: Stone Cairn Lake takes its name from Heroes' Vigil, a stone cairn on the central island honoring Stormwind's soldiers and civilians who died in the First War.

faq.q: Who is currently occupying the central island?
faq.answer: Renegade wizards and other renegades occupy the island, driving away pilgrims and building a fortified camp around the memorial.

faq.q: Why are murlocs gathered around the water?
faq.answer: A local murloc tribe has settled the southern shallows and riverbanks. They build huts along the waterline and claim the plentiful fishing waters as their territory.

faq.q: What is the memorial on the island called?
faq.answer: The memorial is called Heroes' Vigil. Its stone cairn is also known as the Stone of Remembrance.

angles.text: The hills and bluffs around Stone Cairn Lake hold one of Elwynn Forest's heaviest concentrations of copper deposits, drawing aspiring blacksmiths and engineers.
As a human, you can see the island as a memorial to Stormwind's people, honoring those lost when the kingdom fell in the First War.
